title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Chinese Ancient Documents: From OCR to Knowledge Reasoning
reasoning: The AncientDoc benchmark specifically includes 'Confucianism' as one of its 14 document categories. The paper defines this category as works centered on Confucian philosophy and ethics, including interpretations of concepts like benevolence, righteousness, and propriety. By evaluating model performance on these texts through tasks like translation and knowledge-based QA, the paper benchmarks model understanding of this moral and philosophical tradition.
